comparison.objective: Identify the one junction box containing a trapped cable, open only it, reclose it, and pull the cable into a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective lid manipulation and cable extraction rather than impact-driven metal fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Correct box alone is opened and reclosed; the entire cable is released into the tray. Numeric tolerances and damage rules are not provided.
comparison.reason: The tested outcome is selective access and extraction of an extended cable, meaningfully different from stabilizing a mandrel while fracturing and recovering four tiny tangs.
